records.name: Shankesh Jewellers
strengths: Experienced promoters with a presence of over three decades in the jewellery industry.
Established relationships with a large and diversified B2B customer base across India.
An asset-light and scalable business model with a focus on design and quality control.
A consistent track record of financial growth in revenue and profitability.
A wide and diverse portfolio of handcrafted jewellery designs to cater to varied customer demands.
risks: Business success is highly dependent on the ability of its B2B customers to sell to end consumers.
The company’s financial stability is exposed to risks from the volatility of gold prices.
The business is working capital intensive.
Heavy reliance on third-party artisans for the manufacturing of all its jewellery.
Faces significant competition from both organised and unorganised players in the jewellery sector.
records.about_company: Shankesh Jewellers Limited is a B2B company that specializes in handcrafted gold jewellery. The company operates on a pan-India basis from its headquarters in Mumbai, supplying a wide array of jewellery to well-known corporate clients such as Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, and P N Gadgil Jewellers, as well as other non-corporate entities. Shankesh Jewellers follows an asset-light business model, outsourcing the manufacturing process to a network of skilled artisans and job workers, which allows the company to focus on design, customization, and inventory management. Its product portfolio includes a diverse range of 22-karat and 18-karat gold items like bangles, bridal sets, chokers, necklaces, and rings, all hallmarked as per BIS standards. The company generates revenue primarily through the direct sale of its jewellery and also offers custom job work services for clients who provide their own bullion.

records.about_company: Sunshine Pictures Limited is a production house engaged in originating, developing, producing, marketing, and distributing feature films, television programmes, and web series. The company has produced 13 commercial films, including notable successes like “Force,” “Holiday,” and “The Kerala Story,” along with two web series and three television serials. Sunshine Pictures operates on a dual-model strategy, utilizing co-productions with studios to mitigate financial risk while also undertaking sole productions to retain full intellectual property rights and maximize revenue from multiple streams. Revenue is generated from the production and distribution of films and OTT/TV serials, with additional income from its music label “Sunshine Music,” digital content vertical “Sunshine Digital (Originals),” talent management, and social media platforms. The company’s diversified content portfolio and business model position it to capitalize on evolving audience preferences in the Indian media and entertainment industry.

strengths: Largest manufacturer of temperature sensors in India by revenue.
Diversified business across temperature sensing, electrical heating, and specialised cables.
A customized, make-to-order business model creates high entry barriers.
Strong global presence with exports to a wide range of countries.
Backward-integrated manufacturing facilities provide control over the production process.
risks: High concentration of manufacturing units in a single location (Udaipur).
A significant portion of revenue comes from exports, creating foreign exchange risks.
Dependence on the availability and price stability of key raw materials.

records.about_company: Tempsens Instruments is a thermal engineering and specialized cable manufacturer engaged in the design and production of customized temperature-sensing, electrical-heating, and specialized cable solutions. The company operates across three verticals. Its temperature sensing products include thermocouples and infrared pyrometers. The electrical heating segment offers industrial heaters and furnaces, while its cable division manufactures power, control, and instrumentation cables. The company generates revenue by providing custom-built, make-to-order solutions for demanding industries such as steel, petrochemicals, and glass manufacturing. Tempsens utilizes a backward-integrated manufacturing model, allowing control over the entire production cycle from alloy melting to final calibration. With a diversified revenue stream, the company serves both original equipment manufacturer and maintenance markets, maintaining a balanced market presence through domestic sales and an export footprint spanning over 70 countries.

strengths: Operates an integrated seed business covering sourcing, production, processing, quality control, and distribution.
Works with experienced agronomists, field staff, and technicians to maintain seed quality standards.

records.about_company: Dhanwel Hybrid Seeds Limited is engaged in the seed manufacturing business, covering the development, multiplication, processing, and supply of seeds for a range of field crops and vegetables. The company procures breeder and other genetic seed material from recognised agricultural institutions, government-supported research organisations, and the open market. Seed production is carried out through arrangements with seed-growing farmers, where the company provides seed material, cultivation protocols, and technical supervision, while monitoring crop quality through its agronomists and field staff. After harvest, seeds undergo cleaning, grading, treatment, quality checks, packing, and storage at the company’s processing facility in Jamnagar, Gujarat. The company also procures seeds directly from farmers and the open market when required and processes them before sale. Operating in a single business segment, it generates revenue from the sale of seeds marketed under the “Dhanwel Seeds” brand and follows an integrated approach encompassing sourcing, production, quality control, and distribution.

records.about_company: Mopshop Distribution is engaged in the business of providing Facility Management Supplies through a business-to-business model. The company specializes in supplying a diverse portfolio of cleaning tools, hygiene consumables, and maintenance products, including microfiber cloths, surface disinfectants, sensor-based dispensers, biodegradable garbage bags, and vacuum cleaners. Mopshop Distribution serves an extensive client base across multiple industries such as Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, construction, real estate, and healthcare, alongside various facility management companies. The company operates through a proprietary online order management platform, enabling efficient procurement for its roster of over 300 corporate clients across India. With its primary warehousing operations based in Vasai, Maharashtra, the company generates revenue by fulfilling bulk supply orders for functional, durable, and affordable housekeeping and hygiene products, catering specifically to the operational needs of enterprise customers.
